method: Read all 26 answers and authored prompts/rubrics; inspect every distinct attached quote and relevant missing raw-source passages; verify prompt/answer hashes, source PDF/page identities and exact quote/page hashes. grading_policy.unit: Each answer plus its attached exact evidence and the common answer boundary; explanatory omissions remain visible even where the attached quote contains the missing detail.
grading_policy.pass: Meets the bounded prompt and applicable authored expectations using exact source evidence; not specialist acceptance or complete chapter coverage.
grading_policy.partial: Substantive statements are supported, but a requested or explicitly authored qualification, scope distinction or evidence requirement is omitted.
grading_policy.fail: Would indicate contradicted source meaning, unsupported substantive claim, false entitlement/current-law claim or failed provenance. No such outcome was found in this bounded assessment.
grading_policy.alternative_evidence: An exact alternative passage can satisfy the same requirement. Missing a planned locator alone is not automatically a failure.
grading_policy.authority: The rubrics themselves are model-authored, not a specialist gold standard. Grades cannot establish legal correctness.

common_answer_boundary: These answers describe the captured departmental guidance only. They do not establish current legal applicability, decide individual entitlement or provide an award calculation. Verify original PDFs and specialist interpretation.

findings: Exact source grounding is stronger than explanatory completeness: every attached excerpt checked matches frozen text, while 13 answers omit a relevant authored qualification or safeguard.
The 44013 date/transitional note is an acceptable alternative to 44631 for the specified WRAC boundary; requiring a literal locator match would incorrectly reject equivalent evidence.

The most consequential omissions concern negligible work, claimant evidence on disputed debt, ESA(Cont) income exceptions, already-received income, capital actions by others and complete hardship conditions.
limitations: This is a context-aware source trial followed by a different model agent’s assessment; it is not independent human legal review, blind evaluation or a model accuracy benchmark.
The assessment preserves captured-guidance authority only. It does not verify current legislation, actual claimant outcomes, full appendix/case-law dependencies or operational suitability.
No live bundle/browser/WebMCP/voice path or provider API was executed by this assessment; runtime_bundle_binding remains null.
Omitted evidence is grading feedback, not an instruction to rewrite or overwrite the original observed response. A retry needs a separately linked attempt.
